assessment.label: unbalance
assessment.reason: Query shows elevated 1x on all 4 channels (ch0 0.0156, ch1 0.0093, ch2 0.0133, ch3 0.0089) vs normal (~0.0004-0.0016) and misalignment (~0.0003-0.0012) references. 1x dominates 2x on ch0/ch1, matching unbalance references (e.g., 0.010-0.018 ch0, 0.005-0.010 ch1, 0.008-0.015 ch2) rather than misalignment 2x-dominant pattern (2x 0.006-0.015 on ch0/ch2 with low 1x). Absolute levels, rms ~0.037-0.042, crest ~4-6, kurtosis ~3.2-3.4 also match unbalance trials. Looseness also has high 1x but typically shows 2x/3x comparable to or exceeding 1x (e.g., ch3 3x 0.024 >1x 0.014) and higher rms; not seen here. Limitation: radial-only short recording, 3x on ch0 (0.008) is relatively high and looseness/unbalance overlap, so cannot fully exclude looseness.
